newsitem.title: USA: CME AUG PORK BELLIES FALL SHARPLY ON CASH WEAKNESS.
newsitem.headline: CME AUG PORK BELLIES FALL SHARPLY ON CASH WEAKNESS.

text.p: CME August pork belly futures were sharply down amid talk that much lower prices had been paid for pork bellies in the cash market, floor sources said.
There were reports of trade in fresh bellies as low as $84 per cwt, down from $88 to $92 for 12- to 14-lb supplies reported by USDA Wednesday.
Floor sources said Rosenthal Collins and Rand Financial Services were noted sellers of August futures, which at 1049 CDT were down 2.70 cents at 85.20 cents per lb.
